entities.name: Korvold
entities.description: Greedy human king of Eldraine cursed by the fae to become a black-scaled dragon with an insatiable appetite.

events.summary: On his wedding day the fae curse Korvold to become a dragon, and he promptly eats the banquet, gifts and guests.
events.quote: As he was transformed he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests of the wedding.

events.summary: Korvold survives the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Korvold survived the New Phyrexian Invasion .

relations.note: The fae cursed him as punishment.
relations.quote: he was cursed by the fae to become a dragon
